verdict: Organic is holding steady; paid advertising is fully off this period.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, no budget ran on Meta or Google Ads — zero spend, zero paid leads. Your Google Business Profile drove all measurable activity, generating 36 actions including 16 direction requests and 18 website clicks, though that profile activity dropped sharply to zero in the most recent 7 days and is being looked at now. Website traffic told a different story: sessions climbed 44% week over week, with a notable spike around September 1st whose source we're tracing. The site received 213 sessions and 173 users this period, but no conversion events recorded, so the intake funnel is being reviewed to ensure inquiries are captured correctly going forward.
